verses.ar: اِسْمَعُوا أَيُّهَا ٱلْبَنُونَ تَأْدِيبَ ٱلْأَبِ، وَٱصْغُوا لِأَجْلِ مَعْرِفَةِ ٱلْفَهْمِ،
verses.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي أُعْطِيكُمْ تَعْلِيمًا صَالِحًا، فَلَا تَتْرُكُوا شَرِيعَتِي.
verses.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

verses.ar: فَإِنِّي كُنْتُ ٱبْنًا لِأَبِي، غَضًّا وَوَحِيدًا عِنْدَ أُمِّي،
verses.kjv: For I was my father’s son, tender and only [beloved] in the sight of my mother.
verses.web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يُرِينِي وَيَقُولُ لِي: «لِيَضْبِطْ قَلْبُكَ كَلَامِي. ٱحْفَظْ وَصَايَايَ فَتَحْيَا.
verses.kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

verses.ar: اِقْتَنِ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ. ٱقْتَنِ ٱلْفَهْمَ. لَا تَنْسَ وَلَا تُعْرِضْ عَنْ كَلِمَاتِ فَمِي.
verses.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget [it] not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

verses.ar: لَا تَتْرُكْهَا فَتَحْفَظَكَ. أَحْبِبْهَا فَتَصُونَكَ.
verses.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

verses.ar: ٱلْحِكْمَةُ هِيَ ٱلرَّأْسُ. فَٱقْتَنِ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ، وَبِكُلِّ مُقْتَنَاكَ ٱقْتَنِ ٱلْفَهْمَ.
verses.kjv: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

verses.ar: ٱرْفَعْهَا فَتُعَلِّيَكَ. تُمَجِّدُكَ إِذَا ٱعْتَنَقْتَهَا.
verses.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

verses.ar: تُعْطِي رَأْسَكَ إِكْلِيلَ نِعْمَةٍ. تَاجَ جَمَالٍ تَمْنَحُكَ».
verses.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

verses.ar: اِسْمَعْ يَا ٱبْنِي وَٱقْبَلْ أَقْوَالِي، فَتَكْثُرَ سِنُو حَيَاتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

verses.ar: أَرَيْتُكَ طَرِيقَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ. هَدَيْتُكَ سُبُلَ ٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

verses.ar: إِذَا سِرْتَ فَلَا تَضِيقُ خَطَوَاتُكَ، وَإِذَا سَعَيْتَ فَلَا تَعْثُرُ.
verses.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

verses.ar: تَمَسَّكْ بِٱلْأَدَبِ، لَا تَرْخِهِ. ٱحْفَظْهُ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ حَيَاتُكَ.
verses.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let [her] not go: keep her; for she [is] thy life.
verses.web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

verses.ar: لَا تَدْخُلْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، وَلَا تَسِرْ فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْأَثَمَةِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil [men].
verses.web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

verses.ar: تَنَكَّبْ عَنْهُ. لَا تَمُرَّ بِهِ. حِدْ عَنْهُ وَٱعْبُرْ،
verses.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَنَامُونَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا سُوءًا، وَيُنْزَعُ نَوْمُهُمْ إِنْ لَمْ يُسْقِطُوا أَحَدًا.
verses.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause [some] to fall.
verses.web: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُمْ يَطْعَمُونَ خُبْزَ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَيَشْرَبُونَ خَمْرَ ٱلظُّلْمِ.
verses.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.web: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

verses.ar: أَمَّا سَبِيلُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ فَكَنُورٍ مُشْرِقٍ، يَتَزَايَدُ وَيُنِيرُ إِلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ ٱلْكَامِلِ.
verses.kjv: But the path of the just [is] as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

verses.ar: أَمَّا طَرِيقُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ فَكَالظَّلَامِ. لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مَا يَعْثُرُونَ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: The way of the wicked [is] as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، أَصْغِ إِلَى كَلَامِي. أَمِلْ أُذُنَكَ إِلَى أَقْوَالِي.
verses.kjv: ¶ My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

verses.ar: لَا تَبْرَحْ عَنْ عَيْنَيْكَ. اِحْفَظْهَا فِي وَسَطِ قَلْبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا هِيَ حَيَاةٌ لِلَّذِينَ يَجِدُونَهَا، وَدَوَاءٌ لِكُلِّ ٱلْجَسَدِ.
verses.kjv: For they [are] life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

verses.ar: فَوْقَ كُلِّ تَحَفُّظٍ ٱحْفَظْ قَلْبَكَ، لِأَنَّ مِنْهُ مَخَارِجَ ٱلْحَيَاةِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it [are] the issues of life.
verses.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

verses.ar: ٱنْزِعْ عَنْكَ ٱلْتِوَاءَ ٱلْفَمِ، وَأَبْعِدْ عَنْكَ ٱنْحِرَافَ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

verses.ar: لِتَنْظُرْ عَيْنَاكَ إِلَى قُدَّامِكَ، وَأَجْفَانُكَ إِلَى أَمَامِكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا.
verses.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

verses.ar: مَهِّدْ سَبِيلَ رِجْلِكَ، فَتَثْبُتَ كُلُّ طُرُقِكَ.
verses.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

verses.ar: لَا تَمِلْ يَمْنَةً وَلَا يَسْرَةً. بَاعِدْ رِجْلَكَ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
